decisions.evidence: The current published Statement embeds def-interval and def-open-cover-r, and its bisection explanation also links thm-recursion before any Statement references section. This confirms the reported uninterrupted-statement defect. The complete bisection proof uses canonical left-first recursion, nested nonempty intervals and an Archimedean length bound; its singleton a=b case also works. The owned energy proof 1.1 uses exactly compactness of the nonempty closed bounded interval J=[-R,R] for a finite subcover, and supplies its own uniform-continuity argument. The links change no hypothesis or deduction. The read-only import is retained; scoped disposition is nonfatal-recorded and original mathematics editorial maintenance remains OPEN.

The current published Statement embeds def-continuity-real, def-interval and def-derivative in the continuity/differentiability hypotheses, without a following Statement references section. This confirms the reader finding. Its complete auxiliary-function proof forms h=(f(b)-f(a))g-(g(b)-g(a))f, checks equal endpoint values, then applies Rolle; no division or nonvanishing derivative assumption is required. The mean-value corollary specializes g(x)=x, and owned periodic Proof 2.1 uses it only on nondegenerate closed coordinate segments with C1 restrictions. The editorial defect invalidates none of these hypotheses. Read-only import retained; scoped nonfatal-recorded, original mathematics maintenance OPEN.

The current published Statement embeds def-continuity-real, def-interval and def-derivative; its later Statement explanatory paragraph also links thm-fermat-interior-extremum. There is no following Statement references section. The reader finding is confirmed. Its complete proof obtains extrema on the nonempty compact interval, applies Fermat when an extremizer is interior, and otherwise derives constancy from equal endpoint values and uses the midpoint. Both exhaustive cases yield an interior zero derivative. Cauchy and then the mean-value corollary preserve the hypotheses used by owned periodic Proof 2.1. This is nonfatal editorial maintenance; read-only import retained, scoped nonfatal-recorded, original mathematics maintenance OPEN.
